comprehensive_description.scene_content_description: A high-end, cinematic still-life advertisement featuring a thick-bottomed, transparent whiskey glass resting on a dark wooden table. The glass contains amber-colored liquid, and a single transparent ice cube is suspended in mid-air directly above the rim, poised to fall. The background is dark and out of focus, creating a shallow depth of field that isolates the subject. The atmosphere is sophisticated, moody, and luxurious, emphasizing the clarity of the glass and the rich color of the whiskey.
comprehensive_description.camera_movement_description: The camera remains in a stable close-up perspective throughout the duration. There is no significant panning, tilting, or zooming. Instead, the camera exhibits a very subtle, smooth, slow-motion breathing effect, maintaining a steady focus on the glass and the falling ice.
